name: Fine-pitch local fiducials
description: Advisory (needs placement + fiducials): a fine-pitch part (<= 0.5 mm pitch, >= 5 pads: BGA / fine QFN / connector) needs a local fiducial pair so automated placement can correct local error the global fiducials cannot. Flags fine-pitch parts with fewer than 2 fiducials within 40 mm. Not_applicable without placement and at least one fiducial.
what_it_measures: Count of fine-pitch parts lacking a local fiducial pair (< 2 within 40 mm).
